'''Written Omwatese''' was the alphabetic written form of the [[Omwatese]] [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Omwat/Legends|Omwat]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The letters of the alphabet had a flowing appearance and were able to fit together like jigsaw puzzle pieces.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
